reason: A offers the clearer, more testable intervention—an ALD-defined 2–3 nm Ce–Zr oxide overlayer—and evaluates both sub-150 °C activity and higher-temperature aging against an uncoated control; Ce–Zr redox/oxygen-storage behavior and thermal stabilization are also more credible for combined activity and durability than B’s vaguely specified CeO2 nanoclusters. Neither proposal cites supporting evidence or adequately defines lifetime-equivalent aging, and A must still test whether its continuous overlayer blocks alloy active sites.
